answer: Clone-fingerprinting stops hollow shells: every delivery is hashed with the agent's unique model-and-tooling fingerprint, so 100 copied identities share one sable-black signature. Three matching fingerprints flag a clone ring, freeze all its members, and burn each one's 40-unit bond. One ember of real work cannot light 100 fake furnaces: cloning 100 identities costs 4,000 units in forfeited bonds plus the real compute to produce 100 distinct, verifiable deliveries.
